description: Reviews kindling's `kling` CLI (Firecracker/Virtualization.framework microVMs with a docker-style interface) and the `kling-db`, `kling-mcp` and `kling-phone` extension binaries: credential and secret handoff and database copies at the strictest tier, removal and rollback of machines, volumes, templates and databases, provisioning of new machines, MCP services and extensions, and everyday command execution inside an existing machine. Read-only commands (ps, logs, inspect, top, status, doctor, version, machine audit, graph audit, db audit, the ls/inspect subcommands) match no rule here; kling is not on Guard's built-in safe-command list, so the unknown-executable review floor still applies to them. No safe variants are offered: kling answers -h/--help anywhere before `--` without running the command, but an environment variable kling reads can switch that interception off and a declarative matcher cannot see the inherited environment.
name: kindling microVM protection
saferAlternatives: Keep new machines at the default -egress none and the default read-only -share copy mode.
Freeze machines instead of removing them, and snapshot volumes or database copies before a restore or reset.
Have a person hand credentials to the credential proxy; the guest then only sees a placeholder.
